label: ក្រៅពីលុយកាក់ សាច់ញាតិជិតស្និទ្ធមួយចំនួនក៏យកអង្ករ ស្ករ ទឹកត្រី ឬនំនេកដើម្បីចូលរួមការរៀបចំពិធីមង្គលការដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រៅពីលុយ មនុស្សជិតស្និទ្ធខ្លះៗក៏យកអង្ករ ស្ករ ទឹកត្រី ឬនំផ្លែឈើតាមមក ដើម្បីរួមចំណែករៀបចំជប់លៀងមង្គលការ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài tiền bạc, một số bà con thân thích cũng mang gạo, đường, nước mắm hoặc bánh nếp để góp phần chuẩn bị đám cưới.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: besides money, close people bring rice, sugar, fish sauce, and cakes/fruits to contribute to preparing the wedding party. The core meaning of contribution to wedding preparation is intact. Minor semantic looseness appears in rendering “bánh trái” as “នំផ្លែឈើ,” which can be read as “fruit cake” rather than the broader Khmer/Vietnamese cultural sense of cakes and fruit/snacks. “Tiệc cưới” as “ជប់លៀងមង្គលការ” is accurate.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns or honorifics in this sentence. The hypothesis uses “មនុស្សជិតស្និទ្ធខ្លះៗ” for “một số người thân thiết,” which is pragmatically acceptable, though the human reference’s “សាច់ញាតិជិតស្និទ្ធមួយចំនួន” is slightly more socially specific by emphasizing relatives. No breach of Khmer Krom cultural or respect norms is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions: “លុយ,” “អង្ករ,” “ស្ករ,” “ទឹកត្រី,” “នំផ្លែឈើ,” “រួមចំណែក,” and “ជប់លៀងមង្គលការ.” There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. The wording is authentic, though “នំផ្លែឈើ” is a narrower lexical choice than the reference’s culturally broader rendering.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and mostly natural. The construction “ក៏យកអង្ករ ស្ករ ទឹកត្រី ឬនំផ្លែឈើតាមមក” is acceptable, though “តាមមក” after the final noun creates a slightly less polished flow than the reference. “ដើម្បីរួមចំណែករៀបចំជប់លៀងមង្គលការ” is comprehensible and natural enough, though adding a connector such as “ក្នុងការ” would make it smoother.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good-quality translation with the main facts and cultural context preserved. It avoids fake transliteration and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor issues involve slight lexical narrowing of “bánh trái,” less specific social reference compared with the human reference, and somewhat less polished syntactic flow. These do not seriously impair comprehension.

per_sample.text: - Những món quà này mang tính tượng trưng và thiết thực, phản ánh truyền thống tương trợ, đùm bọc lẫn nhau trong cộng đồng Khmer.
label: អំណោយទាំងនេះជានិមិត្តរូប និងជាក់ស្តែង ដែលឆ្លុះបញ្ចាំងពីប្រពៃណីនៃការជួយគ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក និងការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អំណោយទាំងនេះមានលក្ខណៈនិមិត្តសញ្ញា និងមានប្រយោជន៍ជាក់ស្តែង ឆ្លុះបញ្ចាំងពីប្រពៃណីជួយគ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក និងទ្រទ្រង់ថែទាំគ្នា ក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរក្រោម។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Những món quà này vừa mang tính biểu tượng vừa thiết thực, phản ánh truyền thống tương trợ qua lại và sự quan tâm trong cộng đồng Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning well: the gifts are symbolic and practical/useful, and they reflect traditions of mutual assistance and caring/support within the Khmer community. The rendering of “thiết thực” as “មានប្រយោជន៍ជាក់ស្តែង” is semantically acceptable. “đùm bọc lẫn nhau” is conveyed by “ទ្រទ្រង់ថែទាំគ្នា,” which captures mutual support and care. The only notable semantic deviation is that the hypothesis specifies “សហគមន៍ខ្មែរក្រោម” whereas the source and reference say simply “cộng đồng Khmer / សហគមន៍ខ្មែរ.” In a Khmer Krom context this is culturally plausible, but it is still a narrowing/additional specification not explicitly present in the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns, kinship terms, or hierarchical address forms in this sentence. The hypothesis does not introduce any inappropriate subject marking or disrespectful form. The community label “ខ្មែរក្រោម” is regionally legitimate, though slightly more specific than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer. Terms such as “អំណោយ,” “និមិត្តសញ្ញា,” “ជាក់ស្តែង,” “ប្រពៃណី,” “ជួយគ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក,” and “សហគមន៍ខ្មែរក្រោម” are authentic lexical choices. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or corrupted character-copying from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer flow and word order. The structure “អំណោយទាំងនេះមានលក្ខណៈ...” is grammatical and idiomatic. The sequence of coordinated phrases is clear, and the final locative phrase “ក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរក្រោម” is syntactically well placed. Minor stylistic difference from the reference exists, but fluency remains high.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, this is a high-quality translation. It accurately transfers the main informational content and uses fluent, legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The main issue is the added specificity of “Khmer Krom” instead of the more general “Khmer community,” which slightly narrows the meaning compared with the source/reference. Since this term is culturally legitimate in the Khmer Krom setting and does not otherwise distort the sentence, the penalty is minor.

per_sample.text: - Có nơi, khách mời còn mang theo khăn rằn, áo sơ mi hoặc quà nhỏ cho cô dâu chú rể như lời chúc cuộc sống đủ đầy.
label: នៅកន្លែងខ្លះ ភ្ញៀវក៏យកក្រមា អាវ ឬអំណោយតូចៗសម្រាប់កូនក្រមុំ និងកូនកំលោះតាមបំណងប្រាថ្នាសម្រាប់ជីវិតរស់នៅដោយពេញលេញ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មានកន្លែងខ្លះ ភ្ញៀវអញ្ជើញក៏យកក្រម៉ា អាវសឺមី ឬកាដូតូចៗតាមដៃមក ជូនកូនក្រមុំនឹងកូនកំលោះ ដូចជាពាក្យសូមជូនពរឲ្យជីវិតសម្បូរបែប។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ở một số nơi, khách còn mang khăn rằn, áo hoặc những món quà nho nhỏ tặng cô dâu chú rể, như lời cầu chúc cho cuộc sống vợ chồng viên mãn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: in some places, invited guests bring a krama/checkered scarf, shirt, or small gifts for the bride and groom as a wish for an abundant/full life. The phrase 'តាមដៃមក' adds a natural nuance of bringing something along by hand, but it does not distort the meaning. 'ដូចជាពាក្យសូមជូនពរ...' accurately conveys the idea of the gift functioning as a congratulatory wish, though it is slightly more explicit than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns. 'ភ្ញៀវអញ្ជើញ' appropriately represents invited guests, and 'កូនក្រមុំ' and 'កូនកំលោះ' are culturally and pragmatically suitable terms for bride and groom. No honorific or social hierarchy violation is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate in Khmer/K Khmer Krom context. 'ក្រម៉ា' is an acceptable spelling/variant for krama. 'អាវសឺមី' is a recognizable localized borrowing for 'áo sơ mi/shirt' and should not be treated as fake transliteration. 'កាដូ' is a common Khmer loanword for gift and is natural. No incoherent or fake phonetic character-copying is found.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally fluent and understandable. Word order follows natural Khmer structure: location phrase, subject, verb phrase, objects, recipient, and purpose/wish clause. Minor issues include the use of 'នឹង' where standard written Khmer would prefer 'និង' for coordination between bride and groom, and the phrase 'ដូចជាពាក្យសូមជូនពរ' is slightly wordy but still natural enough.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is high quality and accurately transfers the source meaning. It preserves the culturally specific gift items and wedding context, uses appropriate kinship/social terms, and contains authentic localized vocabulary rather than false transliterations. Minor orthographic and stylistic issues prevent a perfect score in morpho-syntax, but the translation remains semantically faithful and culturally sound.

per_sample.text: - Với người lớn tuổi, họ thường chuẩn bị quà chu đáo, có thể kèm theo các vật phẩm phong thủy hoặc trang sức nhỏ làm kỷ niệm.
label: សម្រាប់អ្នកមានវ័យចាស់ គេតែងតែរៀបចំអំណោយដែលគិតគូរឲ្យបានហ្មត់ចត់ ដោយមានភ្ជាប់ជាមួយរបស់របរហុងស៊ុយ ឬគ្រឿងអលង្ការតូចៗជាវត្ថុអនុស្សាវរីយ៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - សំរាប់អ្នកចាស់ៗ ពួកគេតែងតែត្រៀមអំណោយយ៉ាងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ ក៏អាចភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយរបស់ហ្វេងស៊ុយ ឬគ្រឿងអលង្ការតូចៗ អោយជាអនុស្សាវរីយ៍។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đối với người cao tuổi, người ta thường chuẩn bị những món quà được cân nhắc kỹ lưỡng, kèm theo đồ phong thủy hoặc những món trang sức nhỏ làm kỷ niệm.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves most of the core informational content: it refers to older people, preparing gifts attentively, and including feng-shui-related items or small jewelry as keepsakes. However, compared with the human reference, there is a notable ambiguity/distortion in agency. The reference uses the impersonal/general subject “គេ” after “សម្រាប់អ្នកមានវ័យចាស់,” meaning people prepare gifts for older adults. The hypothesis uses “ពួកគេ” immediately after “សំរាប់អ្នកចាស់ៗ,” which can be read as “the older people themselves prepare gifts,” weakening the intended recipient/agent relation. The rest of the propositional content is largely intact.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun choice is the main weakness. “ពួកគេ” is grammatically possible but pragmatically less suitable here because it creates an anaphoric link to “អ្នកចាស់ៗ,” while the reference uses the generic “គេ” to indicate unspecified people preparing gifts for elders. Also, “អ្នកចាស់ៗ” is understandable but slightly more colloquial and less respectful than “អ្នកមានវ័យចាស់.” There is no severe honorific violation, but the social-pragmatic alignment is weaker than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is mostly legitimate Khmer. “ហ្វេងស៊ុយ” is an acceptable loan/transliteration for feng shui and should not be treated as fake phonetic copying, although the reference uses the more Vietnamese/Khmer-localized “ហុងស៊ុយ.” “គ្រឿងអលង្ការតូចៗ” and “អនុស្សាវរីយ៍” are appropriate. Minor orthographic variants such as “សំរាប់” and “អោយ” are common but less standard than “សម្រាប់” and “ឲ្យ/ឱ្យ.” No incoherent or fake transliteration strings are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally understandable and has acceptable Khmer word order. However, “ក៏អាចភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយ” is somewhat awkward in this context; the reference’s “ដោយមានភ្ជាប់ជាមួយ” flows more naturally. The final phrase “អោយជាអនុស្សាវរីយ៍” is comprehensible but less precise than “ជាវត្ថុអនុស្សាវរីយ៍.” Overall, the structure is serviceable but not fully native-polished.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a mostly successful translation with the main problem being pragmatic and semantic ambiguity caused by the subject pronoun “ពួកគេ.” The core message remains recoverable, and the vocabulary is legitimate, including the feng-shui term. Nevertheless, compared to the human reference, the hypothesis is less culturally and syntactically refined, especially in the treatment of the elderly as the object/recipient rather than the possible subject of the action.

per_sample.text: - Trong trường hợp khách không có điều kiện vật chất, chỉ cần đến chung vui và chúc phúc cũng được gia đình hoan nghênh nhiệt tình.
label: ក្នុងករណីដែលភ្ញៀវមិនមានលក្ខខណ្ឌសម្ភារៈ គ្រាន់តែមកចូលរួមសប្បាយ និងជូនពរក៏ទទួលបានការស្វាគមន៍យ៉ាងកក់ក្ដៅពីក្រុមគ្រួសារ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: នៅក្នុងករណីភ្ញៀវមិនមានលក្ខខណ្ឌវត្ថុធាតុ គ្រាន់តែ​មក​រួមសប្បាយ ហើយជូនពរ គ្រួសារក៏ស្វាគមន៍យ៉ាងកក់ក្ដៅដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trong trường hợp khách không có điều kiện vật chất, chỉ cần đến dự vui và chúc phúc thì cũng sẽ được gia đình đón tiếp nồng hậu.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition: if guests lack material means, merely coming to share the joy and offer blessings will still be warmly welcomed by the family. There is no major omission. However, “លក្ខខណ្ឌវត្ថុធាតុ” is less accurate than the reference “លក្ខខណ្ឌសម្ភារៈ”; it sounds closer to 'material substance/raw material conditions' rather than 'material/financial means.' Despite this awkward lexical choice, the intended meaning remains recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or kinship terms. “ភ្ញៀវ” and “គ្រួសារ” are appropriate and socially neutral. The respectful communal tone of welcoming guests is maintained adequately.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted character-copying are present. The vocabulary is generally legitimate Khmer. The main lexical issue is collocational: “វត្ថុធាតុ” is a real Khmer term but is not the best fit for Vietnamese “điều kiện vật chất” in this context; “សម្ភារៈ” or wording referring to material means would be more natural.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. The active construction “គ្រួសារក៏ស្វាគមន៍...” is acceptable, though slightly less polished than the reference’s passive-like “ទទួលបានការស្វាគមន៍...ពីក្រុមគ្រួសារ.” The phrase “មក​រួមសប្បាយ ហើយជូនពរ” is natural enough, though “មកចូលរួមសប្បាយ និងជូនពរ” would be smoother and closer to the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation with the central meaning intact and no culturally inappropriate pronoun or honorific choices. Its main weakness lies in the lexical rendering of 'material conditions' as “លក្ខខណ្ឌវត្ថុធាតុ,” which is semantically awkward but not unintelligible. Syntax and flow are mostly natural, with only minor phrasing differences from the human reference.

per_sample.text: - Người Khmer coi trọng tấm lòng hơn vật chất, nên dù món quà nhỏ nhưng nếu chân thành vẫn được đánh giá rất cao.
label: ប្រជាជនខ្មែរឲ្យតម្លៃលើបេះដូងច្រើនជាងវត្ថុសម្ភារៈ ដូច្នេះហើយ ទោះបីអំណោយតិចតួចក៏ដោយ បើចិត្តស្មោះក៏នៅតែមានតម្លៃខ្ពស់ដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មនុស្សខ្មែរយើង ដាក់សារៈសំខាន់លើទឹកចិត្តជាងលើរបស់របរ ដូច្នេះ ទោះអំណោយតូចតាចក៏ដោយ បើផ្តល់ដោយចិត្តស្មោះ ក៏ត្រូវបានគេវាយតម្លៃខ្ពស់ណាស់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer coi trọng tấm lòng hơn vật chất; vì vậy, dẫu món quà nhỏ bé, nếu chân thành thì vẫn rất đáng quý.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the core meaning: Khmer people value sincerity/inner feeling more than material goods, and even a small gift is highly valued if given sincerely. The rendering of 'tấm lòng' as 'ទឹកចិត្ត' is semantically appropriate and culturally natural. 'វត្ថុសម្ភារៈ' is rendered as 'របស់របរ', which is slightly more concrete but still conveys material things adequately. The phrase 'បើផ្តល់ដោយចិត្តស្មោះ' explicitly states 'if given with a sincere heart,' which is faithful to the intended meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject 'មនុស្សខ្មែរយើង' adds an inclusive 'យើង' absent from the source/reference, but this is pragmatically acceptable in Khmer discourse and does not distort social hierarchy or respect relations. There are no problematic kinship terms, honorifics, or religious markers in this sentence. The inclusive phrasing can sound regionally natural and community-oriented.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted lexical items are present. Terms such as 'ទឹកចិត្ត', 'របស់របរ', 'អំណោយ', 'ចិត្តស្មោះ', and 'វាយតម្លៃ' are legitimate Khmer lexical choices. The vocabulary is authentic and semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and flows smoothly. The construction 'ដាក់សារៈសំខាន់លើ...ជាងលើ...' is grammatical and understandable. The concessive structure 'ទោះ...ក៏ដោយ' and conditional 'បើ...' are correctly used. Overall morpho-syntactic quality is high.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that fully preserves the informational content and pragmatic meaning of the source. Minor differences from the reference, such as the inclusive 'យើង' and the use of 'របស់របរ' instead of the more abstract 'វត្ថុសម្ភារៈ', do not significantly affect meaning or cultural appropriateness. The hypothesis is fluent, authentic, and free from false transliteration.

per_sample.text: - Đặc biệt, khi mừng cưới, người Khmer tránh tặng vật sắc nhọn như dao kéo vì sợ mang ý nghĩa chia cắt tình cảm vợ chồng.
label: ជាពិសេស ពេលផ្តល់អំណោយក្នុងពិធីមង្គលការ ប្រជាជនខ្មែរជៀសវាងការផ្តល់វត្ថុមុតស្រួច ដូចជាកាំបិត និងកន្ត្រៃ ព្រោះខ្លាចមានអត្ថន័យបំបែកគូស្នេហ៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជាពិសេស ពេលធ្វើបុណ្យរៀបការ មនុស្សខ្មែរ ជៀសមិនឲ្យផ្តល់អំណោយជា​អីវ៉ាន់មុតស្រួច ដូចជា កាំបិត កន្ត្រៃ ព្រោះខ្លាចថា​នឹងមានន័យ​កាត់បែក​ទំនាក់ទំនង​ប្ដីប្រពន្ធ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đặc biệt, khi tặng quà trong lễ cưới, người Khmer Nam Bộ tránh tặng các vật sắc nhọn như dao và kéo vì sợ mang hàm ý chia cắt đôi lứa.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the central proposition: Khmer people avoid giving sharp objects such as knives and scissors at weddings because these items may symbolize separation or damage to the husband-wife relationship. The examples and causal explanation are retained. There is a minor semantic shift in rendering 'khi mừng cưới' as 'ពេលធ្វើបុណ្យរៀបការ' ('when holding/doing the wedding ceremony') rather than specifically 'when giving wedding gifts/congratulating the wedding,' but the later phrase 'ផ្តល់អំណោយ' restores the gift-giving context. Overall meaning is intact with slight imprecision.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'មនុស្សខ្មែរ' for Khmer people, which is socially neutral and acceptable, though slightly less formal than the reference's 'ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ.' There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific mismatches. The phrase 'ប្ដីប្រពន្ធ' appropriately represents the husband-wife relationship in this context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted copied Vietnamese forms are present. Terms such as 'កាំបិត,' 'កន្ត្រៃ,' 'អំណោយ,' 'អីវ៉ាន់,' and 'ប្ដីប្រពន្ធ' are legitimate Khmer lexical items. 'អីវ៉ាន់' is more colloquial than the reference's 'វត្ថុ,' but it is not illegitimate and does not indicate machine transliteration noise.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. However, 'ជៀសមិនឲ្យផ្តល់អំណោយជា​អីវ៉ាន់មុតស្រួច' is somewhat awkward compared with the smoother reference construction 'ជៀសវាងការផ្តល់វត្ថុមុតស្រួច.' The phrase 'កាត់បែក​ទំនាក់ទំនង​ប្ដីប្រពន្ធ' is semantically clear but slightly literal. Word order remains acceptable and native-readable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation with the core cultural meaning preserved. It accurately conveys the taboo against gifting sharp objects at Khmer weddings and the symbolic fear of separating the couple. Minor weaknesses include a less precise rendering of the wedding-gift occasion and some awkward phrasing, but there are no serious semantic losses, no culturally inappropriate pronoun choices, and no fake transliteration artifacts.

per_sample.text: - Một số gia đình còn chuẩn bị sẵn thùng ghi danh sách tiền mừng để dễ cảm ơn sau này, rất rõ ràng và minh bạch.
label: គ្រួសារខ្លះថែមទាំងរៀបចំប្រអប់ជាមួយនឹងបញ្ជីអំណោយ សម្រាប់ងាយស្រួលអរគុណនៅពេលក្រោយ ច្បាស់លាស់ និងតម្លាភាព។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - មួយចំនួនគ្រួសារ ក៏ត្រៀមទុកស្រាប់ប្រអប់សម្រាប់កត់ត្រាបញ្ជីប្រាក់អបអរ ដើម្បីងាយស្រួលអរគុណក្រោយមក យ៉ាងច្បាស់លាស់ និងមានតម្លាភាព។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Một số gia đình thậm chí còn chuẩn bị một chiếc hộp kèm danh sách quà tặng để tiện cảm ơn sau này, rõ ràng và minh bạch.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: some families prepare a box in advance, record/list congratulatory money, and do so to facilitate thanking people later in a clear and transparent way. The phrase 'បញ្ជីប្រាក់អបអរ' closely reflects Vietnamese 'danh sách tiền mừng' and is semantically more explicit than the reference's broader 'បញ្ជីអំណោយ'. The nuance of 'còn/thậm chí' is only mildly rendered by 'ក៏', but the core message is intact.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. The subject refers generally to families, and the hypothesis does not introduce any inappropriate social or religious markers. The only issue is syntactic rather than pragmatic: 'មួយចំនួនគ្រួសារ' is less natural than 'គ្រួសារមួយចំនួន' or 'គ្រួសារខ្លះ'.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted lexical forms are present. Terms such as 'ប្រអប់', 'កត់ត្រា', 'បញ្ជី', 'ប្រាក់អបអរ', 'អរគុណ', and 'តម្លាភាព' are legitimate Khmer lexical items. 'ប្រាក់អបអរ' is somewhat literal but still understandable and lexically valid for 'tiền mừng'.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is understandable and mostly grammatical, but the flow is somewhat awkward. 'មួយចំនួនគ្រួសារ' has non-native modifier order; more natural Khmer would be 'គ្រួសារមួយចំនួន' or 'គ្រួសារខ្លះ'. The phrase 'ត្រៀមទុកស្រាប់ប្រអប់' is also slightly stiff; 'រៀបចំប្រអប់ទុកស្រាប់' or 'ត្រៀមប្រអប់ទុកស្រាប់' would flow better. Despite these issues, the word order does not obstruct comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with full recoverability of meaning and no culturally inappropriate pronouns or fake transliterations. Its main weaknesses are minor-to-moderate Khmer fluency issues in word order and phrasing, especially around the subject phrase and preparation phrase. Semantically it is faithful to the source and even preserves the monetary detail more explicitly than the reference.

per_sample.text: - Sau đám cưới, gia đình cô dâu chú rể thường ghi nhớ công mừng để hồi lại khi dự đám cưới của người khác.
label: បន្ទាប់ពីពិធីមង្គលការ គ្រួសាររបស់កូនក្រមុំ និងកូនកំលោះតែងតែចងចាំថ្ងៃមង្គលការ ដើម្បីសងត្រលប់វិញនៅពេលចូលរួមក្នុងពិធីមង្គលការរបស់អ្នកដទៃ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បន្ទាប់ពីស៊ុំការ គ្រួសារកូនក្រមុំណិងកូនកំលោះ តែងតែកត់ចំណាំកុងមឹង ដើម្បីហូយវិញ ពេលទៅរួមស៊ុំការរបស់អ្នកដទៃ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Sau lễ cưới, gia đình nhà gái và nhà trai thường ghi nhớ ngày cưới để đáp lễ khi dự đám cưới của người khác.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad situational frame: after a wedding, the bride and groom's families remember/record something in order to return it when attending another person's wedding. However, the key informational unit is expressed through unclear or Vietnamese-derived forms such as "កុងមឹង" and "ហូយវិញ" rather than the clear reference wording "ចងចាំ... ដើម្បីសងត្រលប់វិញ". The intended meaning is partially recoverable, especially for bilingual readers familiar with Vietnamese, but it is not cleanly or reliably transferred in Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronoun or honorific choices in this sentence. The hypothesis correctly identifies the participants as the bride and groom's family, using "គ្រួសារកូនក្រមុំ...កូនកំលោះ". However, the conjunction is misspelled as "ណិង" instead of "និង", which affects formal appropriateness but does not create a major pragmatic breach.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis contains multiple suspicious Vietnamese-based phonetic renderings rather than fully legitimate Khmer lexical choices. "កុងមឹង" appears to be a direct transliteration of Vietnamese "công mừng"; while the cultural concept is relevant, the form is not established clearly in the reference as an accepted Khmer Krom lexical item. "ហូយវិញ" appears to be copied from Vietnamese "hồi lại" and should be rendered as "សងត្រលប់វិញ" or similar. "ស៊ុំការ" is also problematic for 'wedding' compared with the reference's natural "ពិធីមង្គលការ". These forms create a serious lexical legitimacy issue.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure follows the source order fairly closely and is broadly understandable, but it is not fully natural Khmer. The phrase "គ្រួសារកូនក្រមុំណិងកូនកំលោះ" lacks proper spacing and contains an orthographic error. "ដើម្បីហូយវិញ" is syntactically awkward because the verb is not natural Khmer. "ពេលទៅរួមស៊ុំការ" is also less fluent than the reference's "នៅពេលចូលរួមក្នុងពិធីមង្គលការ".
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis conveys the general wedding-reciprocation scenario, but it relies heavily on Vietnamese-influenced or raw phonetic forms, especially "កុងមឹង", "ហូយវិញ", and "ស៊ុំការ". These are not supported by the human reference as legitimate regional Khmer Krom forms and substantially reduce lexical and stylistic quality. There is no major pronoun or honorific failure, but the morpho-syntax and lexical legitimacy are notably weak. Overall, the translation is partially intelligible but not professionally acceptable.

per_sample.text: - Đây là cách người Khmer duy trì mối quan hệ cộng đồng bền chặt, ai giúp mình thì mình cũng sẽ giúp lại khi họ cần.
label: នេះជារបៀបដែលប្រជាជនខ្មែររក្សាទំនាក់ទំនងសហគមន៍រឹងមាំ ប្រសិនបើមាននរណាម្នាក់ជួយអ្នក អ្នកក៏នឹងជួយពួកគេនៅពេលពួកគេត្រូវការ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - យ៉ាងនេះហើយជាវិធីដែលមនុស្សខ្មែរ ថែរក្សាទំនាក់ទំនងសហគមន៍ឲ្យរឹងមាំ អ្នកណាដែលជួយខាងយើង ខាងយើងក៏នឹងជួយតបវិញ ពេលខាងគេត្រូវការ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đây là cách người Khmer giữ gìn sự gắn kết cộng đồng vững chắc: nếu ai đó giúp bạn, bạn cũng sẽ giúp họ khi họ cần.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis fully preserves the core meaning of the source and the human reference: it states that this is the way Khmer people maintain strong community relationships, and that if someone helps us, we will help them in return when they need it. The reciprocal-help proposition is accurately rendered with no substantive omission or distortion.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun and participant choices are culturally and pragmatically appropriate. The use of 'មនុស្សខ្មែរ' for 'người Khmer' is acceptable, and 'ខាងយើង' / 'ខាងគេ' effectively expresses the reciprocal social sides involved in mutual assistance. There is no inappropriate honorific mismatch or social-register error.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'ថែរក្សា', 'ទំនាក់ទំនងសហគមន៍', 'រឹងមាំ', and 'ជួយតបវិញ' are authentic and contextually suitable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and fluent phrasing. The structure 'អ្នកណាដែលជួយខាងយើង ខាងយើងក៏នឹងជួយតបវិញ' is idiomatic and clearly conveys reciprocity. The flow is smooth and readable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the source meaning, maintains appropriate community-oriented pronoun usage, uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and reads naturally. Minor stylistic differences from the reference, such as 'មនុស្សខ្មែរ' instead of 'ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ' and 'ខាងយើង/ខាងគេ' instead of 'អ្នក/ពួកគេ', do not reduce accuracy or cultural appropriateness.

per_sample.text: - Tôi nghĩ quà cưới trong văn hóa Khmer không chỉ là vật chất, mà còn là biểu hiện của sự gắn bó và sẻ chia.
label: ខ្ញុំគិតថា អំណោយអាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ មិនត្រឹមតែជាសម្ភារៈប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ ប៉ុន្តែក៏ជាការបង្ហាញពីការភ្ជាប់គ្នា និងការចែករំលែកផងដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំគិតថា អំណោយមង្គលការ ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ មិនត្រឹមតែរបស់របរប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ តែថែមទាំងជាការបង្ហាញពីភាពភ្ជាប់ជាប់ និងការចែករំលែកផងដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng quà cưới trong văn hóa Khmer không chỉ là vật chất, mà còn là sự thể hiện của sự gắn kết và sự sẻ chia.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source and matches the human reference closely: the speaker thinks that wedding gifts in Khmer culture are not merely material objects but also express attachment/bonding and sharing. "អំណោយមង្គលការ" is a valid rendering of "quà cưới" and conveys the wedding-gift concept. The phrase "របស់របរ" for "vật chất" is slightly less abstract than the reference's "សម្ភារៈ", but the intended contrast between material things and symbolic/social meaning remains clear. "ភាពភ្ជាប់ជាប់" conveys connectedness, though it is somewhat less idiomatic than "ការភ្ជាប់គ្នា" or a term closer to emotional/social bonding.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of "ខ្ញុំ" for "Tôi" is appropriate and neutral. There are no problematic kinship terms, honorifics, or religious/social hierarchy markers in this sentence. The hypothesis maintains the same pragmatic stance as the source and reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear to be legitimate Khmer vocabulary. "អំណោយមង្គលការ" is a natural Khmer expression for wedding gift. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or character-copying from Vietnamese. Terms such as "វប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ", "ការបង្ហាញ", and "ការចែករំលែក" are standard and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and mostly natural in Khmer. The structure follows a clear pattern: opinion marker, subject matter, negated contrastive clause, and additive contrast. However, "ភាពភ្ជាប់ជាប់" is slightly awkward as a collocation and less fluent than the reference's "ការភ្ជាប់គ្នា". The spacing before "ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ" is non-critical.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with full preservation of the main message and no culturally inappropriate phrasing. The main weaknesses are minor lexical and stylistic issues: "របស់របរ" slightly concretizes "vật chất", and "ភាពភ្ជាប់ជាប់" sounds somewhat awkward compared with the reference. These do not obstruct comprehension or distort the central meaning. No pronoun or transliteration problems are present.

per_sample.text: - Cảm ơn anh rất nhiều, những chia sẻ của anh giúp em hiểu rõ hơn về nét đẹp trong văn hóa cưới của người Khmer.
label: អរគុណបងច្រើនណាស់ អំពីការចែករំលែករបស់បងនាំឱ្យខ្ញុំយល់កាន់តែច្បាស់ ពីភាពស្រស់ស្អាតនៃវប្បធម៌អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អរគុណបងច្រើនណា ការចែករំលែករបស់បងជួយអោយអូនយល់ច្បាស់កាន់តែឡើងអំពីសម្រស់ក្នុងវប្បធម៌រៀបការរបស់ខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cảm ơn anh nhiều lắm, những chia sẻ của anh đã giúp em hiểu rõ hơn về vẻ đẹp của văn hóa cưới hỏi của người Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core message: thanking the older interlocutor for sharing, and stating that the sharing helps the speaker understand more clearly the beauty of Khmer wedding/marriage culture. Minor differences include rendering “rất nhiều” as “ច្រើនណា,” which is understandable but slightly less complete/natural than “ច្រើនណាស់,” and “văn hóa cưới” as “វប្បធម៌រៀបការ,” which is acceptable though slightly less formal than the reference’s “វប្បធម៌អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍.” No major informational unit is lost.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “បង” for Vietnamese “anh” and “អូន” for “em.” This is pragmatically appropriate in a Khmer kinship-pronoun system, especially where the speaker positions themself as younger/lower relative to the addressee. The human reference uses the more neutral “ខ្ញុំ,” but “អូន” is not culturally or pragmatically wrong in this context. Respect toward the addressee is maintained.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer: “អរគុណ,” “បង,” “ការចែករំលែក,” “ជួយអោយ/ឱ្យ,” “យល់ច្បាស់,” “សម្រស់,” “វប្បធម៌,” and “រៀបការ” are authentic lexical items. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. The use of “រៀបការ” instead of the more formal “អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍” is a valid lexical choice.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. However, “យល់ច្បាស់កាន់តែឡើង” is somewhat awkward; a more natural order would be closer to “យល់កាន់តែច្បាស់.” The phrase “សម្រស់ក្នុងវប្បធម៌រៀបការ” is acceptable but slightly less polished than the reference’s “ភាពស្រស់ស្អាតនៃវប្បធម៌អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍.” Overall flow is good but not fully native-polished.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation with the core meaning intact, culturally appropriate kinship pronouns, and authentic Khmer vocabulary. Its main weaknesses are minor naturalness and register issues, especially the slightly awkward placement in “យល់ច្បាស់កាន់តែឡើង” and the less formal wording for wedding culture. These do not seriously impair comprehension or cultural appropriateness.

per_sample.text: - Chào anh, anh có thể chia sẻ về trang phục cưới truyền thống của nam giới Khmer được không ạ?
label: សួស្តីបង! តើបងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីសំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ប្រពៃណីរបស់បុរសខ្មែរបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: សួស្តីបង, បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីសម្លៀកបំពាក់រៀបការតាមប្រពៃណីរបស់បុរសខ្មែរបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chào anh! Anh có thể chia sẻ về trang phục cưới truyền thống của đàn ông Khmer được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the full core meaning of the source and the human reference: a polite greeting followed by a request asking the older male addressee to share about traditional Khmer men's wedding attire. The phrase សម្លៀកបំពាក់រៀបការតាមប្រពៃណី accurately conveys 'traditional wedding clothing,' corresponding well to សំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ប្រពៃណី in the reference. No informational unit is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses បង for 'anh,' matching the social-pragmatic relationship in the source and the human reference. This is appropriate for respectful address toward an older male or socially senior interlocutor in Khmer/Kmer Krom contexts. The polite interrogative structure បានទេ is also suitable. There is no pronoun misuse or culturally inappropriate leveling.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. សួស្តី, បង, ចែករំលែក, សម្លៀកបំពាក់, រៀបការ, តាមប្រពៃណី, បុរសខ្មែរ are authentic Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese or corrupted character-copying. The use of រៀបការ instead of អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ is a natural lexical alternative and not an error.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and fluent morpho-syntactic structure. The sequence បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពី...បានទេ is idiomatic and matches the expected question form. Modifier placement in សម្លៀកបំពាក់រៀបការតាមប្រពៃណីរបស់បុរសខ្មែរ is acceptable and clear. Punctuation differs slightly from the reference, using a comma instead of an exclamation mark after the greeting, but this does not affect grammaticality or meaning.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly faithful, fluent, and culturally appropriate. It preserves the greeting, respectful address, request structure, and topic of traditional Khmer men's wedding attire. The lexical choice រៀបការតាមប្រពៃណី is slightly less formal than អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ប្រពៃណី but fully legitimate and semantically equivalent in this context. No fake transliteration, pronoun error, or syntactic disruption is present.

per_sample.text: - Dạ, trang phục cưới của đàn ông Khmer rất đặc biệt, thể hiện sự trang trọng và nét văn hoá dân tộc rõ rệt.
label: បាទ! សំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍របស់បុរសខ្មែរពិតជាពិសេសណាស់ ដែលបង្ហាញពីភាពឧឡារិកអធិកអធម និងប្លែកពីវប្បធម៌ជាតិយ៉ាងច្បាស់លាស់។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចា ខោអាវរៀបការរបស់បុរសខ្មែរពិសេសខ្លាំងណាស់ បង្ហាញភាពផ្លូវការ និងលក្ខណៈវប្បធម៌ជាតិច្បាស់លាស់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dạ! Trang phục cưới của đàn ông Khmer thật sự rất đặc biệt, toát lên vẻ uy nghi, cao sang và khác biệt rõ ràng so với văn hóa quốc gia.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: Khmer men's wedding attire is very special and clearly expresses formality/solemnity and national-cultural characteristics. The phrase "ខោអាវរៀបការ" is a simpler rendering of "សំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍" but semantically adequate. "ភាពផ្លូវការ" captures formality, though it is slightly less elevated than the reference's "ភាពឧឡារិកអធិកអធម" and the Vietnamese "trang trọng". No major factual distortion or omission is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic subject pronouns or kinship terms. The initial polite response "ចា" corresponds broadly to Vietnamese "Dạ" and is pragmatically acceptable, though the reference uses "បាទ", which is a more explicitly polite masculine/formal response. This is a minor register variation rather than a serious cultural or pragmatic error.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "ខោអាវ", "រៀបការ", "បុរសខ្មែរ", "ពិសេស", "ភាពផ្លូវការ", and "លក្ខណៈវប្បធម៌ជាតិ" are all authentic lexical items. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or corrupted character-copying from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and natural in Khmer. Word order is clear, and the adjectival and complement structures are understandable. The style is somewhat more colloquial and less ceremonious than the reference, especially with "ខោអាវរៀបការ" and "ពិសេសខ្លាំងណាស់", but the flow remains fluent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation. It accurately conveys the central meaning and uses legitimate Khmer expressions without transliteration artifacts. Minor weaknesses are mainly stylistic and register-related: the rendering is less formal and culturally elevated than the human reference, especially for the idea of solemn ceremonial dignity. These issues do not prevent comprehension or substantially alter the message.

per_sample.text: - Chúng tôi thường mặc sampot chang kben, là loại váy quấn truyền thống, kết hợp với áo dài tay được thêu hoa văn tinh xảo.
label: យើងខ្ញុំតែងតែស្លៀកសំពត់ចងក្បិន ជាស្លៀកពាក់សំពត់ខ្លីបែបប្រពៃណី រួមនឹងអាវដៃវែងដែលមានប៉ាក់យ៉ាងប្រណិត។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ពួកយើងតែងតែពាក់សំពត់ចងក្បិន ដែលជាសំពត់រុំបែបប្រពៃណី រួមជាមួយអាវដៃវែង ដែលដេរលំនាំល្អិតល្អន់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chúng tôi thường mặc xà-rông buộc kiểu châng kben, tức loại xà-rông ngắn truyền thống, kèm theo áo tay dài thêu rất tinh xảo.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content very well: the speaker group usually wears sampot chang kben, described as a traditional wrapped skirt, combined with a long-sleeved shirt/blouse with fine decorative patterns. No major facts are omitted or distorted. The rendering of 'váy quấn truyền thống' as 'សំពត់រុំបែបប្រពៃណី' is semantically accurate, and the description of embroidery as 'ដេរលំនាំល្អិតល្អន់' conveys the intended idea of intricate patterning, though it is slightly less precise than explicitly saying 'embroidered' as in the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'ពួកយើង' for 'Chúng tôi', while the human reference uses the more polite/formal 'យើងខ្ញុំ'. In this context, 'ពួកយើង' is understandable and not socially inappropriate, but it is slightly less aligned with the deferential or formal collective tone of the reference. There are no kinship or religious honorific issues in this sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer expressions. 'សំពត់ចងក្បិន' is an authentic cultural garment term corresponding to sampot chang kben, not a fake phonetic transliteration. 'សំពត់រុំ', 'អាវដៃវែង', and 'លំនាំល្អិតល្អន់' are also valid Khmer lexical items. There is no evidence of raw automated character-copying or illegitimate transliteration.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The overall word order is natural and intelligible. The structure 'ពួកយើងតែងតែពាក់...' flows well. 'ដែលជាសំពត់រុំបែបប្រពៃណី' is syntactically sound. The phrase 'អាវដៃវែង ដែលដេរលំនាំល្អិតល្អន់' is understandable but slightly awkward because the shirt is described as 'sewing patterns' rather than more naturally 'having embroidered patterns' or 'being embroidered'. This is a minor morpho-syntactic and lexical collocation issue, not a serious grammatical failure.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation. It accurately transfers the meaning, uses authentic Khmer vocabulary, and maintains a natural overall structure. The main shortcomings are the slightly less formal pronoun 'ពួកយើង' compared with the reference's 'យើងខ្ញុំ', and the mildly awkward collocation 'ដែលដេរលំនាំល្អិតល្អន់' for embroidered intricate patterns. These issues do not impede comprehension or cultural appropriateness.

per_sample.text: - Màu sắc phổ biến là màu vàng, đỏ hoặc trắng, tượng trưng cho sự may mắn, giàu có và tinh khiết trong ngày cưới.
label: ពណ៌ដែលពេញនិយមគឺពណ៌លឿង ក្រហម ឬស ដែលតំណាងឲ្យសំណាង ទ្រព្យសម្បត្តិ និងភាពបរិសុទ្ធក្នុងថ្ងៃមង្គលការ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ពណ៌ពេញនិយមគឺ ពណ៌លឿង ក្រហម ឬស ដែលជាតំណាងឲ្យសំណាងល្អ សម្បត្តិ និងភាពបរិសុទ្ធ នៅថ្ងៃរៀបការ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Những màu được ưa chuộng là vàng, đỏ hoặc trắng, tượng trưng cho may mắn, tài lộc và sự tinh khiết trong ngày cưới.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves all core informational units from the source and reference: the popular colors are yellow, red, or white, and they symbolize luck/good fortune, wealth, and purity on the wedding day. per_sample.text: - Trên đầu, chú rể đội khăn krama hoặc đội mũ truyền thống tùy theo nghi lễ của gia đình và vùng miền.

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - លើក្បាល កូនកំលោះពាក់ក្រមា ឬពាក់មួកប្រពៃណី ទៅតាមពិធីរបស់គ្រួសារ និងតំបន់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chú rể đội khăn rằn hoặc mũ truyền thống, tùy vào gia đình và nghi lễ theo từng vùng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the core information: the groom wears either a krama or a traditional hat on his head, and the choice depends on the family ceremony and regional practice. The phrase “ទៅតាមពិធីរបស់គ្រួសារ និងតំបន់” is semantically close to the reference “អាស្រ័យលើគ្រួសារ និងពិធីតាមតំបន់,” though it slightly compresses the dependency relationship. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject “កូនកំលោះ” is appropriate and matches the reference. There are no problematic pronouns or kinship/honorific terms in this sentence. The register is culturally suitable for describing a wedding custom.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer or accepted cultural vocabulary. “ក្រមា” is the correct and culturally authentic rendering of krama. “មួកប្រពៃណី,” “ពិធី,” “គ្រួសារ,” and “តំបន់” are all natural Khmer terms. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The structure is natural and understandable Khmer: “លើក្បាល កូនកំលោះពាក់...” is acceptable, though the reference’s “នៅលើក្បាលកូនកំលោះ” is slightly smoother. The repetition “ឬពាក់មួកប្រពៃណី” is grammatical and clear. Overall word order and phrase flow are good, with only minor stylistic differences from the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that faithfully conveys the meaning of the source and matches the human reference closely. It uses culturally appropriate wedding vocabulary and authentic Khmer lexical choices. Minor differences in phrasing and syntactic smoothness do not affect comprehension or cultural validity.

per_sample.text: - Áo thường được may bằng vải hoặc vải lụa gấm, có khi đính kim tuyến hoặc pha lê nhỏ để tạo sự nổi bật và trang trọng.
label: ជាធម្មតា អាវបានដេរអំពីក្រណាត់ឬក្រណាត់សូត្រ ជួនកាលតុបតែងដោយពន្លឺចែងចាំង ឬគ្រីស្តាល់តូចៗ ដើម្បីបង្កើតភាពលេចធ្លោ និងឧឡារិកអធិកអធម។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - អាវភាគច្រើនតែងតែដេរពីក្រណាត់ ឬសូត្រលំនាំក្បាច់; ពេលខ្លះក៏ប៉ាក់ខ្សែរលោងភ្លឺៗ ឬត្បិតគ្រីស្តាល់តូចៗ ដើម្បីឲ្យមើលទៅលេចធ្លោ និងម៉ឺងម៉ាត់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Thông thường, áo được may từ vải hoặc lụa, đôi khi được đính hạt lấp lánh hoặc những viên pha lê nhỏ để tạo nên vẻ nổi bật và sang trọng bậc nhất.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: the garment is usually sewn from fabric or silk/brocade-like patterned silk, may be decorated with shiny elements or small crystals, and the purpose is to make it stand out. However, there are minor semantic shifts. “đính kim tuyến” is rendered as embroidering shiny threads, which is close but not exactly the same as attaching sequins/metallic decorative material. “trang trọng” is translated as “ម៉ឺងម៉ាត់,” meaning serious/strict, which is less accurate than solemn, formal, or dignified. Overall, the core meaning is retained with some nuance loss.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns, kinship terms, religious honorifics, or social hierarchy markers in this sentence. The subject “អាវ” is appropriate and culturally neutral. No pragmatic or honorific misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is generally legitimate Khmer. “គ្រីស្តាល់” is a common and acceptable borrowing for crystal and also aligns with the reference. “សូត្រលំនាំក្បាច់” is an acceptable descriptive rendering for brocade/patterned silk. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or corrupted character-copying. Some lexical choices such as “ម៉ឺងម៉ាត់” are semantically less ideal but not illegitimate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is largely fluent and natural in Khmer. The phrase “ភាគច្រើនតែងតែ” is somewhat redundant but understandable. The structure around “ប៉ាក់ខ្សែរលោងភ្លឺៗ ឬត្បិតគ្រីស្តាល់” is slightly awkward, especially “ត្បិតគ្រីស្តាល់,” where a verb like “បិត” or “ភ្ជាប់” would be more natural for attaching crystals. Still, the overall word order and sentence flow are coherent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation overall. It successfully conveys the main message and uses authentic Khmer vocabulary without fake transliteration. The main weaknesses are minor semantic imprecision in the rendering of “kim tuyến” and a less accurate translation of “trang trọng” as “ម៉ឺងម៉ាត់.” Syntax is understandable and mostly natural, though with slight awkwardness and redundancy.

per_sample.text: - Phần trang sức cũng rất quan trọng, chú rể thường đeo vòng tay, dây chuyền vàng và thắt lưng có hoa văn truyền thống.

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ផ្នែកគ្រឿងអលង្ការក៏សំខាន់ណាស់ដែរ, កូនកំលោះតែងតែពាក់កងដៃ ខ្សែកមាស និងខ្សែក្រវាត់ដែលមានលំនាំប្រពៃណី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trang sức cũng rất quan trọng. Chú rể thường đeo vòng tay, dây chuyền vàng và thắt lưng có hoa văn truyền thống.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves all core informational units from the source and the human reference: jewelry is important, the groom customarily wears wrist jewelry, a gold necklace, and a belt with traditional patterns. The addition of ផ្នែក reflects the Vietnamese 'Phần' and does not distort meaning. កងដៃ is semantically acceptable for 'vòng tay' as bracelet/bangle, comparable to the reference ខ្សែដៃ.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject កូនកំលោះ for 'chú rể' is appropriate and matches the human reference. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics. The sentence maintains culturally suitable reference to the groom in a wedding context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: ផ្នែក, គ្រឿងអលង្ការ, កូនកំលោះ, កងដៃ, ខ្សែកមាស, ខ្សែក្រវាត់, លំនាំប្រពៃណី. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. កងដៃ is an authentic lexical choice for wrist ornamentation.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and mostly natural. The phrase ផ្នែកគ្រឿងអលង្ការ is slightly more literal than the reference គ្រឿងអលង្ការ but remains understandable and acceptable. Word order and modifier placement are correct, especially in ខ្សែក្រវាត់ដែលមានលំនាំប្រពៃណី.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with full semantic preservation and culturally appropriate terminology. The only minor weakness is a slightly literal rendering of 'Phần trang sức' as ផ្នែកគ្រឿងអលង្ការ and the use of Western punctuation, but these do not impede comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: - Trang phục này không chỉ đẹp mắt mà còn mang giá trị tâm linh, thể hiện lòng kính trọng với tổ tiên và cộng đồng.
label: សំលៀកបំពាក់នេះមិនត្រឹមតែស្រស់ស្អាតប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ ថែមទាំងមានតម្លៃខាងវិញ្ញាណផងដែរ បង្ហាញពីការគោរពដល់បុព្វបុរស នឹងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ឈុតខោអាវនេះ មិនត្រឹមតែស្អាតភ្នែកទេ តែក៏មានតម្លៃផ្នែកវិញ្ញាណ ហើយបង្ហាញក្តីគោរពចំពោះបុព្វបុរស និងសហគមន៍ផងដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Bộ trang phục này không chỉ đẹp mà còn mang giá trị tinh thần, thể hiện sự tôn kính đối với tổ tiên và cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis fully preserves the source meaning: the clothing/outfit is not only visually beautiful but also has spiritual value and expresses respect toward ancestors and the community. No factual content is omitted or distorted. The rendering of “đẹp mắt” as “ស្អាតភ្នែក” is semantically appropriate, and “តម្លៃផ្នែកវិញ្ញាណ” accurately conveys spiritual value.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or kinship terms requiring complex pragmatic calibration. The respectful phrase “ក្តីគោរពចំពោះបុព្វបុរស និងសហគមន៍” appropriately conveys reverence toward ancestors and the community without violating Khmer/KKhmer Krom sociolinguistic expectations.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical choices are legitimate Khmer expressions. “ឈុតខោអាវ,” “ស្អាតភ្នែក,” “តម្លៃផ្នែកវិញ្ញាណ,” “បុព្វបុរស,” and “សហគមន៍” are authentic and contextually valid. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or automated character-copying from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer flow and coherent clause linkage: “មិនត្រឹមតែ...ទេ តែក៏...” correctly renders the contrastive-additive structure of the Vietnamese source. Word order and phrase structure are fluent, with only very minor stylistic difference from the reference, not affecting quality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers all informational and cultural content. It uses acceptable Khmer vocabulary, preserves the spiritual and communal respect dimensions, and maintains natural syntax. Differences from the reference are stylistic rather than erroneous.

per_sample.text: - Trước khi cưới, gia đình thường chuẩn bị bộ đồ cưới từ sớm và đôi khi được may đo riêng theo dáng của chú rể.
label: មុនពេលរៀបមង្គលការ គ្រួសារតែងតែរៀបចំសំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍មុន ហើយពេលខ្លះក៏បានដេរអោយសំនឹងរូបកូនកំលោះផងដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មុនពេលរៀបការ គ្រួសារតែងតែរៀបចំឈុតខោអាវរៀបការតាំងពីមុន ហើយពេលខ្លះក៏ដេរតាមវាស់ឲ្យសមតាមរាងកាយរបស់កំលោះផង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trước khi tổ chức đám cưới, gia đình thường chuẩn bị trang phục cưới từ trước, và đôi khi còn may đo theo dáng của chú rể nữa.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content: before the wedding, the family prepares the wedding clothing in advance, and sometimes it is tailored to fit the groom's body. The meaning of preparation, timing, wedding attire, and custom fitting is all recoverable. Minor nuance loss occurs with 'តាំងពីមុន', which conveys 'from before/in advance' but is slightly less precise than 'từ sớm' / 'from early'. The phrase also does not explicitly render 'riêng' as strongly as the source, though the tailoring idea is retained.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronoun or honorific issues in this sentence. The family subject 'គ្រួសារ' is appropriate. The term 'កំលោះ' is understandable in context, but 'កូនកំលោះ' would more accurately match the wedding-role term 'chú rể' as used in the reference. This is a minor pragmatic/lexical precision issue rather than a serious social-register failure.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'មុនពេលរៀបការ', 'គ្រួសារ', 'ឈុតខោអាវ', 'រៀបការ', 'វាស់', 'សម', and 'រាងកាយ'. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese copied into Khmer script. 'រៀបការ' and 'ឈុតខោអាវរៀបការ' are less formal than the reference's 'រៀបមង្គលការ' and 'សំលៀកបំពាក់អាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍', but they are lexically legitimate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. However, 'ដេរតាមវាស់ឲ្យសមតាមរាងកាយ' is somewhat awkward; a more natural phrasing would be closer to 'ដេរតាមខ្នាតឲ្យសមនឹងរូបកូនកំលោះ' or the reference's 'ដេរអោយសំនឹងរូបកូនកំលោះ'. Word order remains acceptable, but the tailoring phrase has noticeable non-native stiffness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation. It accurately conveys the main meaning and contains no fake transliterations. The main weaknesses are minor: slightly less formal wedding terminology, the use of 'កំលោះ' instead of the more role-specific 'កូនកំលោះ', and an awkward tailoring construction. These issues do not block comprehension or distort the core message, so the translation falls in the Good range.

per_sample.text: - Một số gia đình còn thuê nghệ nhân truyền thống để thiết kế hoạ tiết thêu tay theo biểu tượng may mắn của người Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and the human reference: present time, coexistence/mixing with modern style, many young Khmer people, and continued preservation of ancestral wedding clothing traditions. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation. per_sample.text: Anh có thể chia sẻ một vài câu tục ngữ Khmer liên quan đến kinh nghiệm đồng áng mà bà con vẫn thường nhắc đến không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the overall communicative message: in the community, a rice-related saying/proverb reminds farmers to observe nature carefully before making decisions. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is broadly successful in conveying the overall message and pragmatic context, with appropriate pronouns and no culturally inappropriate forms. Therefore, semantic and lexical scores are lowered, while pronoun use and syntactic flow remain strong.

linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with the core meaning preserved and culturally appropriate pronoun usage. per_sample.text: Vậy trong đời sống hằng ngày, tinh thần khiêm tốn được thể hiện qua những câu nói hay bài học nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the overall interrogative meaning: it asks how, in daily life, a quality related to modesty is expressed through words or lessons. The main semantic weakness is the rendering of 'tinh thần khiêm tốn' as 'ចិត្តរាបស្មើ'. While related to a calm or even-tempered disposition, 'រាបស្មើ' more literally suggests evenness/levelness and is less precise than the reference's 'ស្មារតីនៃភាពរាបសា', which directly expresses humility/modesty. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally overall: 'តើ...ត្រូវបានបង្ហាញតាមរយៈ...អ្វីខ្លះ?' is a well-formed Khmer question structure. Word order is acceptable. The phrase 'ចិត្តរាបស្មើ' is somewhat less idiomatic for 'spirit of humility' than the reference's 'ស្មារតីនៃភាពរាបសា', but it does not disrupt overall syntactic comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is generally good and communicatively successful. The main limitation is the central conceptual phrase 'tinh thần khiêm tốn', which is rendered as 'ចិត្តរាបស្មើ' rather than a more precise Khmer expression for humility such as 'ស្មារតីនៃភាពរាបសា'. There are no pronoun/honorific problems and no fake transliterations. Overall, the hypothesis is high quality with a notable but non-fatal lexical-semantic nuance issue.

per_sample.text: Ông bà thường dặn “Cây lúa càng trĩu hạt càng cúi đầu”, ý chỉ con người càng giỏi giang thì càng phải sống khiêm nhường và chan hòa.
label: ឪពុកម្តាយតែងតែទូន្មានថា "ដើមស្រូវកាន់តែធ្ងន់គ្រាប់ កាន់តែឱនក្បាល" ដែលមានន័យថា មនុស្សកាន់តែមានចំណេះដឹងខ្ពស់ ក៏កាន់តែត្រូវរស់នៅដោយសុភាពរាបសារ និងចេះចុះសម្រុង។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cha mẹ thường răn dạy rằng: “Bông lúa càng trĩu hạt càng cúi đầu”, nghĩa là người càng có học thức càng phải sống khiêm nhường, nhã nhặn và biết nhường nhịn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proverb and its intended moral lesson: as rice bears more grain it bows down, and as people become more capable they should live humbly and harmoniously. The rendering of “Ông bà” as “តាយាយ” is semantically appropriate and arguably closer to the source than the reference’s “ឪពុកម្តាយ.” Minor semantic weakening occurs in “ស្រូវកាន់តែពេញក្បាល” compared with the fuller image of “ដើមស្រូវ...ធ្ងន់គ្រាប់,” and “រួសរាយរាក់ទាក់ជាមួយគេ” conveys friendliness but is slightly less precise than “chan hòa/ចុះសម្រុង” meaning socially harmonious and accommodating.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns. The kinship term “តាយាយ” is culturally natural and appropriate for Vietnamese “ông bà,” referring to grandparents or elders who give moral instruction. The tone is respectful and suitable for a proverb-like admonition.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary throughout: “តាយាយ,” “បង្រៀន,” “ស្រូវ,” “ក្បាល,” “ពូកែ,” “បន្ទាបខ្លួន,” and “រួសរាយរាក់ទាក់.” There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or automated character-copying from Vietnamese. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in Khmer. The comparative structure “កាន់តែ... កាន់តែ...” is correctly used. The phrase “កោងក្បាលចុះ” is understandable but a little less idiomatic than “ឱនក្បាល” for bowing the head. Overall syntax and word order are natural with only minor stylistic awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately conveys the proverb and moral meaning. It is culturally and pragmatically appropriate, with no false transliterations. Minor reductions in imagery and nuance prevent a perfect score: “ពេញក្បាល” is less precise than “ធ្ងន់គ្រាប់/trĩu hạt,” and “រួសរាយរាក់ទាក់ជាមួយគេ” captures friendliness more than the fuller idea of social harmony. linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and aligns closely with the human reference: it asks whether the addressee can share about important traditional customs of the Khmer people in connection with religious festivals. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately conveys the source meaning, uses culturally and pragmatically appropriate address forms, and contains authentic Khmer vocabulary. per_sample.text: Với chúng tôi, ngày lễ tôn giáo không chỉ là dịp để cầu nguyện, mà còn là dịp gắn kết cộng đồng trong phum sóc.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đối với chúng tôi, các lễ hội tôn giáo không chỉ là dịp để cầu nguyện, mà còn là dịp để củng cố tinh thần đoàn kết cộng đồng trong phum sóc quê nhà.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main proposition: for the speaker group, a religious holiday is not only for prayer but also for community bonding. The rendering of “gắn kết cộng đồng” as “រួបរួមសហគមន៍” is semantically close, though the reference’s “ពង្រឹង សាមគ្គីភាពសហគមន៍” more explicitly conveys strengthening solidarity. “ថ្ងៃបុណ្យសាសនា” is acceptable for “ngày lễ tôn giáo,” though slightly less ceremonial than “ពិធីបុណ្យសាសនា.” The main semantic weakness is the handling of “phum sóc,” rendered as the malformed “ភូម-សុក” instead of the authentic Khmer “ភូមិស្រុក,” which weakens the culturally specific final locative phrase.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The phrase “សម្រាប់ពួកយើង” appropriately corresponds to “Với chúng tôi” and matches the human reference. There are no problematic shifts in social hierarchy, religious respect, or kinship/pronominal usage. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most vocabulary is legitimate Khmer: “ថ្ងៃបុណ្យសាសនា,” “ឱកាស,” “ការអធិស្ឋាន,” “រួបរួមសហគមន៍” are understandable and lexically valid. However, “ភូម-សុក” appears to be a direct phonetic transliteration of Vietnamese “phum sóc” rather than an authentic Khmer/Khamer Krom form. The human reference uses “ភូមិស្រុក,” which is the appropriate culturally grounded Khmer expression. This is a notable lexical legitimacy failure, though it is isolated to one expression.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The overall sentence structure is fluent and understandable: “មិនមែនត្រឹមតែ...ទេ ប៉ុន្តែក៏...” is a natural contrastive correlative structure. Word order is generally acceptable, and the relation between prayer and community unity is clear. Minor issues include punctuation/spacing differences and the awkward final phrase “នៅក្នុងភូម-សុក,” where the malformed lexical item disrupts native flow.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is largely successful in conveying the main meaning and uses appropriate first-person plural reference. Its syntax is mostly natural and the religious/community message is recoverable. However, the culturally important term “phum sóc” is mishandled as “ភូម-សុក,” a non-native-looking phonetic copy rather than the legitimate Khmer “ភូមិស្រុក.” This prevents a fully native Khmer Krom rendering and significantly lowers the lexical legitimacy score, while semantic and syntactic quality remain generally good.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition: in various ceremonies, the practice of offering/donation is often mentioned, and the speaker asks whether 'bong' can explain its meaning and method. The passive phrasing in the reference 'ត្រូវបានលើកឡើងជាញឹកញាប់' is rendered as the impersonal active 'គេច្រើននិយាយអំពី', which is semantically equivalent in context. The clause 'តើបងអាចពន្យល់អត្ថន័យ និងរបៀបធ្វើវាបានទេ?' is understandable and acceptable, though 'ពន្យល់ពីអត្ថន័យ' and 'របៀបអនុវត្ត' would be slightly more formal and closer to the reference. The word order is native-like, with only minor stylistic informality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is high quality and accurately conveys the source meaning. It uses culturally appropriate Buddhist terminology and preserves the interpersonal address 'បង'. Minor differences are stylistic rather than substantive: the passive reference construction is changed to an impersonal active construction, and 'របៀបធ្វើវា' is slightly less formal than 'របៀបអនុវត្ត'. No fake transliteration or serious grammatical issue is present.

per_sample.text: Cúng dường là khi người dân mang gạo, hoa quả, bánh trái đến chùa để dâng lên chư tăng, thể hiện lòng thành kính và biết ơn.
label: ការបូជា គឺជារបៀបដែលប្រជាជននាំយកអង្ករ ផ្លែឈើ នំចំណី ទៅវត្តអារាម ដើម្បី ប្រគេន ព្រះសង្ឃ បង្ហាញពីសេចក្តី ជ្រះថ្លា និងការដឹងគុណ។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Việc cúng lễ là cách người dân mang gạo, trái cây, bánh và thức ăn đến chùa để cúng dường chư Tăng, thể hiện tấm lòng trong sáng và lòng biết ơn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning: people bring rice, fruit/cakes to the pagoda to offer to monks and express reverence and gratitude. It uses “ការថ្វាយទាន” for the act of religious offering, which is semantically appropriate. There is a minor informational mismatch/addition: “ផ្កា” flowers is explicitly added, while the human reference renders “hoa quả” as fruit rather than flowers. However, this does not seriously distort the overall Buddhist offering context. “អំណរគុណ” conveys thanks, though “ការដឹងគុណ” would more directly match gratitude.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns or inappropriate kinship terms. “ប្រជាជន” is appropriate for 'người dân'. The respectful reference “ព្រះសង្ឃ” is correct. However, the verb “ថ្វាយដល់ព្រះសង្ឃ” is somewhat less culturally precise than “ប្រគេនព្រះសង្ឃ,” which is the more conventional Khmer Buddhist verb for offering to monks. This is a pragmatic-religious register issue but not a severe failure.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted Vietnamese-to-Khmer character copying. Terms such as “ការថ្វាយទាន,” “អង្ករ,” “ផ្លែឈើ,” “នំ,” “វត្ត,” and “ព្រះសង្ឃ” are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The phrase “គោរពកោតកូវ” is somewhat unusual or stylistically marked compared with more standard expressions such as “ជ្រះថ្លា,” “គោរព,” or “កោតសរសើរ,” but it is not evidence of fake transliteration.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and fluent in Khmer. The temporal/definitional structure “គឺពេល...” is natural enough, though slightly less formal than the reference’s “គឺជារបៀបដែល...”. Coordination with “និង” and “ហើយ” is understandable. The overall word order is acceptable, with only minor awkwardness in the phrase “ថ្វាយដល់ព្រះសង្ឃ” and “គោរពកោតកូវ.”
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation that conveys the main message accurately and uses mostly authentic Khmer Buddhist vocabulary. The main weaknesses are minor semantic over-specification with “ផ្កា,” less precise religious verb choice for offerings to monks, and slightly awkward devotional phrasing. There is no major omission, no serious semantic distortion, and no fake transliteration.

per_sample.text: Vậy nghi thức cúng dường này có ảnh hưởng đến đời sống tinh thần của bà con như thế nào?

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vậy thì lễ cúng này có ảnh hưởng như thế nào đến đời sống tinh thần của bà con?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and the human reference: it asks how this offering/almsgiving ritual affects the spiritual or mental life of the community. The phrase “មានឥទ្ធិពលលើជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្តរបស់បងប្អូនយ៉ាងម៉េច” accurately conveys “có ảnh hưởng đến đời sống tinh thần của bà con như thế nào.” The rendering “ពិធីដាក់ទាននេះ” is semantically close to the Buddhist-context notion of “nghi thức cúng dường,” though slightly more specifically framed as almsgiving/donation than the reference’s broader “ពិធីបូជា.” This does not cause a substantive semantic loss.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “បងប្អូន” for “bà con,” matching the reference and appropriately reflecting a communal, respectful address suitable for Khmer/K Khmer Krom sociolinguistic context. No inappropriate pronoun leveling or disrespectful form appears. The colloquial discourse marker “ចឹង” is acceptable for “vậy” in conversational Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. “ដាក់ទាន” is an authentic Buddhist/religious lexical choice referring to giving alms or making offerings, not a fake phonetic transliteration. There are no raw Vietnamese-copy transliterations or corrupted strings.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and natural: “ចឹង ពិធីដាក់ទាននេះ មានឥទ្ធិពលលើ...យ៉ាងម៉េច?” follows acceptable Khmer word order. The placement of “យ៉ាងម៉េច” at the end is fluent and idiomatic in spoken Khmer. Spacing and phrase integration are also acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation that accurately preserves the question’s intent, social address, and Buddhist cultural context. The main difference from the reference is the lexical choice “ដាក់ទាន” instead of “បូជា,” but this is a legitimate and contextually plausible Khmer religious term rather than an error. Overall, it matches the source and reference very closely with only a minor nuance shift.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves all core informational units from the source and the human reference: creating opportunities, each individual/person, accumulating or increasing merit, reminding people to live morally/good lives, and maintaining a strong relationship with the temple. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer: "ឱកាស/ឲ្យ", "មនុស្សម្នាក់ៗ", "បុណ្យកុសល", "សីលធម៌", "ទំនាក់ទំនង", and "វត្តអារាម" are authentic lexical items. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a high-quality translation that faithfully captures the source and aligns closely with the human reference. per_sample.text: Ngoài nghi thức cúng dường, âm nhạc có vai trò gì trong các lễ hội tôn giáo của người Khmer?
